lede: The biggest item this week is at Telluride Town Council on Monday the 22nd, where a vote on converting two affordable ownership units at 215 East Colorado into employee dwelling units — removing their price caps — could permanently reshape how that housing functions for locals. The Housing Authority takes up the same question earlier that day. Meanwhile, Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission moves on a first-phase Land Use Code rewrite that will set development rules for that community for years to come, and the Gondola Subcommittee digs into the fundamental question of who controls and funds the gondola project.

notable.stake: Vote to remove price caps on two affordable units, changing their status permanently.
Resolution to convert deed-restricted ownership units to employee dwelling units.
Ordinance to adopt Phase I Land Use Code changes affecting Norwood development rules.
Key decision on who controls gondola project funding and direction.
Commission votes on leak forgiveness requests and a new leak-check fee.
